description: Teach data-backup-manager to discover backup surfaces generically from canonical storage and manifest metadata rather than scenario-specific code paths. This includes scenario class-root discovery, resource runtime-root discovery, default include/exclude behavior by storage class, and ingestion of declarative exception metadata for the small number of non-default cases.
name: data-backup-manager-manifest-driven-discovery
title: Implement manifest-driven discovery in Data Backup Manager
